nodes.title: Requirements: custom nodes and models
widgets_values:
## Minimax-H3-Komikku · Requirements

Update ComfyUI first: the MiniMax H3, FLUX 3 Klein and MOSS-Image nodes are recent core nodes.

### Custom nodes

| Node pack | Used for |
|---|---|
| **Minimax-H3-Komikku** (this pack) | Komikku Page & Shots, Komikku Page Compose |
| [ComfyUI-Pixaroma](https://github.com/pixaroma/ComfyUI-Pixaroma) | Sliders, Seed, Group Switch, Labels, group frames |
| [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) | Power Lora Loader, Any Switch |
| [comfyui-obvpm](https://github.com/chanon/comfyui-obvpm) | Load Images & Compose (Picture 1-4) |
| [Comfyui-ZNGB-SceneDetect](https://github.com/zhinangubei/Comfyui-ZNGB-SceneDetect) | Scene detect (needs `pip install scenedetect`) |
| [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) | Video Combine, Load Video Path, Select Filename |

Core nodes ([ComfyUI](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI)): MiniMax H3 Reference To Video, MiniMax H3 Sigma Shift, Model Attention Backend, Resolution Selector, Math Expression, Reference Multi Latent, Empty Flux 2 Latent Image, Model Sampling Flux, Image Scale To Total Pixels, KSampler, SamplerCustomAdvanced, Rebatch Images, Preview Any, Save Image.

### Models

The workflow loads them from the subfolders shown (`minimax/`, `flux3/`, `moss/`). Put the files there or pick them again in the loaders.

**MiniMax H3** · [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)
- `diffusion_models/minimax/` [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- `text_encoders/minimax/` [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)
- `vae/minimax/` [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- `vae/minimax/` [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)
- `loras/minimax/accelerators/` [taomate_h3_3step_comfy.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/chfm/TaoMate-H3-3Step-ComfyUI/resolve/main/taomate_h3_3step_comfy.safetensors), the 3-step LoRA ComfyUI conversion of [TaoLiveAIGC/TaoMate-H3](https://huggingface.co/TaoLiveAIGC/TaoMate-H3)

**FLUX 3 Klein** · [black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy)
- `diffusion_models/flux3/` [flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors)
- `text_encoders/` [qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors)
- `vae/` [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors)

**MOSS-Image** (hi-res fix, optional) · [Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image)
- `diffusion_models/moss/` [moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- `text_encoders/moss/` [qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- `vae/` flux2-vae.safetensors (same file as Klein)
- `loras/moss/` 8-steps-dmd-lora.safetensors: [lora.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lodestones/MOSS-Image-SFT-8-steps-dmd/resolve/main/lora.safetensors) from [lodestones/MOSS-Image-SFT-8-steps-dmd](https://huggingface.co/lodestones/MOSS-Image-SFT-8-steps-dmd), renamed

Each model keeps its own license; check it before commercial use.

nodes.title: Page & shots (Komikku)

widgets_values: Extend and upscale this image to fill the entire new canvas edge to edge. Keep exactly the same art style, line work, colors, lighting, characters, faces, hairstyles, outfits, poses and setting. Continue the scene naturally beyond the original edges as one single continuous view: every object, figure and light source from the original appears only once, never repeated, mirrored or tiled. No borders, no letterboxing and no new people.

nodes.title: 5 MP pass prompt
Manga page (preview, save from the node)

widgets_values: {"text": "Load up to 4 reference pictures: Picture 1 is <Picture 1> in the subjects text, and so on. One picture can stack several images (sheet,\nturnarounds). Empty pictures are skipped.", "fontSize": 14, "fontFamily": "Arial", "fontColor": "#ffffff", "textAlign": "left", "backgroundColor": "#5a8cff", "padding": 10, "borderRadius": 6, "opacity": 1, "fontWeight": "normal", "lineHeight": 1.25}

{"text": "1. Open Page Editor: pick a template or draw panels (also
slanted / polygons), number them and write one shot per
panel.
2. Fill subjects, style, soundscape and music. Each panel's
aspect ratio comes from the page.", "fontSize": 14, "fontFamily": "Arial", "fontColor": "#ffffff", "textAlign": "left", "backgroundColor": "#5a8cff", "padding": 10, "borderRadius": 6, "opacity": 1, "fontWeight": "normal", "lineHeight": 1.25}

{"text": "Duration sets the video length and the cut timestamps (split
by the shot lengths set in the page editor).
Video MP: H3 resolution, 0.5 recommended. Panel MP: size of
each Klein panel.
H3 steps: 3 with the taomate LoRA.
The hi-res switch repaints every panel with MOSS-Image at up
to 5 MP; turn it off to use the Klein panels as they are.", "fontSize": 14, "fontFamily": "Arial", "fontColor": "#ffffff", "textAlign": "left", "backgroundColor": "#5a8cff", "padding": 10, "borderRadius": 6, "opacity": 1, "fontWeight": "normal", "lineHeight": 1.25}

{"text": "Run once, then click Open Page Editor on the
compose node to frame each panel image, add
bubbles, text and images. Save and run again:
only the page is recomposed.
The page and the video are previews only (temp
folder). When the page looks right, use Save to
Disk or Save to Output on the Manga page node.", "fontSize": 14, "fontFamily": "Arial", "fontColor": "#ffffff", "textAlign": "left", "backgroundColor": "#5a8cff", "padding": 10, "borderRadius": 6, "opacity": 1, "fontWeight": "normal", "lineHeight": 1.25}
